title: PolicyProfileReference
description: Which versioned policy profile a mission is being judged against, pinned to an immutable content hash. A mission without one has no policy-required findings and no policy gate. Selection is a HUMAN act recorded with a verified identity — a model may never select or change a profile, because the profile is the thing that decides what its output will be measured against.

version.description: Human-facing version. The HASH is what binds an acceptance; this exists so people can talk about it.

version_hash.description: Content hash of the sealed profile, recomputed from content on every load. A mismatch is refused, never warned about. An acceptance made under this hash does not survive a change to it.

scope.description: What this profile is allowed to speak about. provider and iac_tool are frozen literals: widening the platform must be a visible contract change, not a data change.

selected_by.description: Verified user id from the server session. Never client-supplied.
